resolution: User appreciation, no code change. The prop part-texturing work (req_0757/req_0766) paid off end-to-end: the user screenshotted the blocky player, had Gemini render it as a Darkthrone 'Transilvanian Hunger' album-cover parody, uploaded that image in the PAINT panel, and skinned the album-cover prop's face with it in-game (next to the turntable). Confirms the click-a-part -> upload-an-image -> it-just-works flow lands for a non-technical creative goal. Nothing to build; logging the positive outcome.
